captured.method: standalone capture plugin (project .opencode/plugin/capture.js in a scratch git repo) subscribing to every Hooks key; `opencode run --agent build` on gpt-5.6-luna; user's global shoal plugin active (enforce mode)

runs.A: default agent (monika): main bash ok; task->applier denied by native permission before child creation (monika's task allowlist excludes applier)
runs.B: --agent build: task->applier auto-rejected by `opencode run` (task permission is ask); env failure
runs.C: --agent build + project opencode.json permission task/edit/bash/write allow: task applier ok, task general ok, task no-such-role-xyz failed; prompt contained literal #direct

captured.note: shapes only; ids are equal/not-equal notes; values kept only for enumerations (tool, agent, status, type)

args_by_tool.edit_write: NOT OBSERVED: with this model every edit arrived as apply_patch

input.agent: string | undefined (main in default run: undefined; with --agent: the agent; child: always the role)
input.messageID: undefined for main, string msg_* for child

info.parentID: undefined for main | main sessionID for child
info.title: string
info.agent: undefined for main | role name for child

properties.info: same as session.get result; main gets agent set after first prompt

assistant.parentID: user msg id of the turn

facts.q1_session_identity: tool hooks give only sessionID; parentID and agent come from client.session.get({path:{id}}) (works inside the hook, returns {data} wrapper-compatible object) or from a cache built from event session.created (parentID, agent set at creation, before the child's first tool call)
facts.q1_throw_denies: not re-tested live; existing evidence: opencode.ts header 'E0 verified', E0-RESULTS.md:15, guard-opencode.test.ts:212 (LEAF thrown)
facts.q1_child_edit_tool: gpt-5.6-luna children edited via apply_patch (args.patchText), never edit/write; mirror already handles apply_patch
facts.q2_bash_before_args_command_field: command (string, full text); main and child identical shape
facts.q3_chat_message_carries_prompt_text: yes: output.parts[].text; literal #direct detected in main chat.message (promptContainsDirect=true); child's chat.message text is the task prompt, no #direct
facts.q3_chat_message_turn_id: output.message.id; tool hooks have no message id, only the same sessionID; turn id of a tool call is derivable via message.part.updated(callID->assistant messageID->parentID)
facts.q4_task_success_signal: tool.execute.after fires with output.metadata.sessionId; plus event session.created(child, parentID, agent) and message.part.updated state.status=completed
facts.q4_task_failure_signal: tool.execute.before fired (subagent_type not validated yet, shoal logged allow); NO session.created, NO chat.message, NO tool.execute.after; only message.part.updated state.status='error' with state.error string

q4_failure_messages.unknown_agent: Unknown agent type: <name> is not a valid agent type
q4_failure_messages.permission_denied_by_ruleset: The user has specified a rule which prevents ... (lists task allowlist)
q4_failure_messages.run_auto_reject: permission requested: task (<role>); auto-rejecting -> The user rejected permission to use this specific tool call

facts.q4_role_really_started: event session.created with info.parentID==main and info.agent==role (or task.after metadata.sessionId)
facts.q5_turn_end_event: main: session.status {status:{type:'busy'}} then {type:'idle'} then session.idle {sessionID}; fires once per run for main (not between tool steps); also fires per child session
facts.q5_can_block_at_idle: event hook type is (input:{event})=>Promise<void>: no return value or output object, cannot block. SDK client has session.prompt/promptAsync/abort methods (types only; behavior after idle NOT tested)
facts.q6_internal_agents_via_chat.params: chat.params agent='title' fires for the title generation call in main session (no tool hooks)
facts.q7_shoal_plugin_observed: guard.jsonl (enforce mode) logged prompt state and task dispatch allow for each task call, including subagent_type=no-such-role-xyz (shoal does not validate role existence); no deny or throw seen
facts.permission_environment: monika (default agent) task allowlist excludes applier/plan-critic/researcher/watcher; `opencode run` auto-rejects any 'ask' permission, so run with project opencode.json permission allow for task
not_determined: whether shoal guard saw child bash (it ignores bash)
